aggregation.bounds: Successful summary residuals clipped [-100,100]; retain uncapped error and clipping flag in evidence. Interval endpoints clipped [-100,100]. Failed bias bounds are not observed directional bias.
aggregation.control: Equal four control types; equal S seeds within first three types; singleton replay identity. No diagnostic episode is added to primary denominator.
aggregation.evidence: One record per unique statistical seed, all own episode durations including replay on first seed. Seed score .9 primary quality + .1 average of three seed-control qualities and global replay quality. Cases and evaluator-owned baseline outputs retained under solution. First seed also carries paired whole-seed bootstrap of average candidate-minus-baseline bounded loss, 500 draws RNG109. Smoke has one independent replicate, never a scientific precision claim.
aggregation.failure: Loss 1, squared error 10000, bias lower=-100 upper=100, coverage=0, interval width=200. Never remove or renormalize failed cases. Baseline failure retains same penalties. Independent successful baselines survive candidate failure.
aggregation.failure_rate: failed primary/control/replay divided by entire fixed episode count
aggregation.primary: Equal seeds within each cell; equal four mechanisms, two assignments, three graphs. Thus each primary has weight 1/(24*S).

study_plan.assignments: Bernoulli .5 per node; Bernoulli .5 per topology block. At most 64 attempts to obtain nonempty arms; no experiment retries.
study_plan.claim_assessment: Publication separately requires supported paired comparisons and uncertainty, all strata and negative/failed runs, scope limitations, latest official ICML paper/template/rules and checklist, reproducibility code and access restrictions. No final-driven selection or feedback.

controls.anchor: each statistical seed first SBM/no-interference/Bernoulli primary cell
controls.budgets: all controls use same observations and per-method work allowance as primary; no feedback to candidate from comparisons
controls.constant: same anchor inputs except y=2.75; checked GATE zero within 2e-6
controls.permuted: anchor y unchanged, new z permutation preserving counts; at least ceil(n/4) changed labels and changed exposures, reject otherwise after at most 64 proposals; SeedSequence([seed,777]). Null target zero; stochastic residual is measured, never an automatic validity gate.
controls.replay: exact first anchor input and seed after ALL primary/auxiliary episodes; checked recipe and coefficients reproduce within tolerance
controls.shift: same anchor y+3.25; checked GATE equal anchor within atol=rtol=2e-6

study_plan.final_correct: All 865 production episodes on full shapes valid/complete, same checks and sealed final resources; not superiority, paper acceptance, or automatic claim support.
study_plan.generation: CPython 3.12, numpy 1.26.4. Substreams SeedSequence([seed,graph_index,tag]); tags graph=10,x=20,assignment=30 plus assignment_index,noise=40. Same x/noise/assignment paired across mechanisms. Seed values never select workload. Evaluators carry complete simulation implementation.

graphs.blocks: sorted-neighbor BFS over original node IDs, disconnected roots increasing; partition traversal into 16 equal consecutive blocks
graphs.final: SBM and BA same parameters n=4000; full real Stanford3 n=11586,m=568309
graphs.search: SBM four equal blocks p_in=50/n,p_out=10/n; BA m=10; WS k=20,p=.1; n=2000
graphs.smoke: first seed, induced vertices 0..127, actual production public archive loader still executes

study_plan.inference: 95% graph-block sandwich from actual penalized bread and block score meat, G/(G-1); pinv rcond1e-12, rank tolerance1e-10. If G<2 or n<=rank use [-100,100]. Difference-in-means uses observed-design block weighted score radius; zero/copy controls have point intervals. These are diagnostics, not guaranteed network-robust coverage under misspecification.
study_plan.limitations: Scaffold is a bounded operational simulation study, not a completed paper or causal proof. Public graph is one fixed topology reused across seeds; size/degree confound topology comparisons. Sixteen BFS blocks and sandwich intervals may be miscalibrated; record measured coverage. No exhaustive internal-learning claim or adaptivity gate. Single-file native smoke uses Landlock/seccomp; brokered production uses harness isolation. Publication requires writing/compilation and broader analysis after investigation.
study_plan.outcomes: Baseline .3*x0-.2*x1+.2*center(log1p(degree)); direct (1+.4*x0)*z. Independent noise .5*N(0,1) plus topology-block noise .3*N(0,1). Mechanisms: no spillover; e; 1.5*I(e>.75); .8*mean_neighbor(e)+.7*z*e. Isolate exposures zero. Truth is exact finite-population all-treated minus all-control mean, independently recomputed by evaluator.
study_plan.protocol: reset + begin + at most eight 8-MiB decoded uploads + fit (commit) + release = 12 calls, including one-chunk setup/commit/release. No state exports/imports and no shared filesystem. Table sums primary, three controls/seed, and one trailing replay. Contract and manifest reset arrays enumerate the complete broker-visible transcript, including the sole trailing replay reset.
study_plan.recipes: Linear 8 columns or augmented 12, sum-squared loss plus lambda*nonintercept squared norm, lambda in [0,.01,.1,1]. Min norm SVD rcond 1e-12. No scaling except log-degree centering. Numerical fit/endpoint/control atol=rtol=2e-6. Finite abs coefficients/gate <=1e6.
study_plan.scientific_validity: Evaluator-owned fit and endpoint verification, finite/integrity checks, nonvacuous matched controls and reset replay. Self-reported state flags confer no authority. Observed y is permitted fitting data, endpoint truths never sent.
study_plan.search_eligibility: All 217 production episodes including baselines and controls valid and complete, exact reset transcript, disjoint normalized content, no leakage. No improvement or coverage threshold; negative/conditional/unresolved findings remain eligible. Harness ranks eligible candidates by combined_score.

timing.baseline_time_floor: none in canonical task; never count startup, cancellation or sleeping as productive work
timing.baseline_workers: none; six trusted synchronous bounded numerical methods, no nested subprocesses; expected baseline failures retain identity and trigger reset-only drain
